moments.title: UK Singles Chart: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's record
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' made history on the Official UK Singles Chart (chart from August 14th, valid this week) by becoming the longest-running UK number one single of all time.

angles.name: Chart history
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is the longest-running UK Number 1 single ever. What a track!

angles.name: Still number one
angles.copy: Still got 'Rein Me In' on repeat? Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's record-breaking single is making waves. Catch it on Nation Hits!

angles.name: Longest reign
angles.copy: 61 weeks and counting! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are officially chart legends. What's your favourite long-running Number 1?

moments.title: Jean-Michel Jarre turns 78

angles.name: Electronic pioneer

angles.name: Jarre's soundscapes
angles.copy: From 'Oxygène' to 'Équinoxe', Jean-Michel Jarre redefined electronic music. Wishing him a very happy 78th today!
